app_fee.value: International applicants pay a nonrefundable USD 70 per application (USD 60 for U.S. students).
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable $60 fee for U.S. students and $70 for international students is charged for each regular or supplemental application

fee_waiver.value: Several university waivers exist but some exclude international applicants (for example the economic-disadvantage waiver); recruitment-event and open-house waivers do apply.
fee_waiver.quote: Note: International students are not eligible for some fee waivers.

also.quote: International students are not eligible but are encouraged to research EducationUSA Opportunity Funds, which, if awarded, can be used to pay the application fee.
If you attended the Graduate Engineering Open House in October, you are eligible for an application fee waiver from Ohio State.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no general GRE rule; each program decides whether to require it (see the program record).
gre_general.quote: A standardized test score (GRE or GMAT) is required only if: | your program requires the score

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 minimum (4.0 on the updated TOEFL launched January 2026); many programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: 79 on the TOEFL iBT or TOEFL iBT Home Edition (4.0 on the updated TOEFL launched January 2026)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 minimum; many programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5 on the IELTS Academic test or IELTS Online

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, and English-medium teaching alone does not exempt you, so Indian applicants need a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo score.
english_waiver.quote: Note: If your courses were taught in English but you do not meet either of the above exceptions, you are still required to submit proof of English proficiency.

also.quote: We are not granting test waivers or petitions to exempt countries not currently listed above at this time.

notes: Duolingo 120 is also accepted by the Graduate School, but some programs accept only TOEFL and IELTS.
